services.name: New Single-Family Residential Construction Permit
services.description: Zoning review and municipal approval for building a new single-family dwelling on an approved residential lot in Edison Township.
required_documents: Completed Edison Township Zoning Permit Application signed by owner and applicant
Three (3) copies of current property survey prepared by a NJ licensed land surveyor (scale 1"=20' or 1"=30')
Dimensioned building architectural plans showing proposed dwelling footprint, height, and setbacks
Grading and stormwater plot plan approved by Division of Engineering

submission_routing.desk: Division of Zoning, Edison Municipal Complex

services.name: Residential Improvement Permit (Addition, Deck, Pool, Shed, Fence)
services.description: Zoning compliance review for residential additions, unenclosed decks, inground or above-ground swimming pools, storage sheds, and fences exceeding 6 feet.
services.fee_info: $50 (Fence/Shed <200 sq.ft.), $75 (Deck / Above-Ground Pool), $100 (Addition / Shed >200 sq.ft.), $150 (In-Ground Pool)
required_documents: Completed Zoning Permit Application signed by both applicant and deed owner
Three (3) copies of signed and sealed property survey showing exact dimensions, setbacks, and proposed structure footprint
For pools: Barrier fence enclosure plan (min 4ft high with self-closing/latching gate) and filter location
For decks: Confirmation of minimum 15ft rear yard setback and lot coverage calculations

submission_routing.desk: Division of Zoning, Edison Municipal Complex

services.name: Street Opening & Right-of-Way Road Excavation Permit
services.description: Permit for trenching, utility connection cuts, curb alterations, and road openings across municipal rights-of-way and streets.
services.fee_info: $150.00 application filing fee + $5,000.00 pavement restoration guarantee bond / deposit
required_documents: Active State 811 'Call Before You Dig' utility locate ticket confirmation number
Trench dimension sketch (length, width, depth) and backfill specification
Certificate of Insurance ($1M general liability naming Township of Edison as certificate holder)
Edison Police Traffic Division safety review (if blocking travel lanes)

submission_routing.desk: Department of Public Works, Edison Municipal Complex

services.name: Tree Removal & Protection Clearance
services.description: Under Edison Township Municipal Code Chapter 34 (Tree Protection), removal of trees exceeding 6 inches diameter at breast height (DBH) requires prior municipal inspection and clearance.
services.fee_info: Standard residential tree removal permit fee per tree; fee waived for documented hazardous/dead trees
required_documents: Tree removal clearance request with plot sketch showing tree locations and diameter
Certified tree expert (CTE/LTE) arboricultural evaluation if claiming dead/hazardous status
Tree replacement plan or contribution to the Edison Municipal Tree Reforestation Fund

submission_routing.desk: Division of Engineering / Tree Officer Desk, Municipal Complex

services.name: Sewer Connection Charge & Tap-In Allocation
services.description: Mandatory sewer utility application to evaluate wastewater flow allocation and calculate connection charges for new construction or property additions.
services.fee_info: Calculated by plumbing fixture unit schedule per Edison Township municipal code
required_documents: Plumbing isometric plan and fixture unit count breakdown
Civil site plan showing proposed sanitary lateral sewer connection to municipal main

submission_routing.desk: Edison Sewer Utility Division, Municipal Complex
